_readme: WHY THE JOB COUNTS DIFFER (DECISIONS.md, W4, 7 October 2026). Five stories print five job
totals for the same twelve counties. The hub renders this file as a five-row table
(PV.jobCounts, index/#job-counts), and a story whose number is a row here prints a one-line
link to it at the foot of that number (PV.differsLink) once its row is marked linked.
Each row names the story's claim that prints the total. verify_consistency.py [jobcounts]
fails a row whose total or year is not in that claim's own words, or whose total is not in
the hub's index-headcount-key claim (which re-reads every total from its page's data file);
tools/disclosure.mjs fails a table that differs from this file, a linked story with no link,
and a link on a page with no linked row. Unlinked rows are printed as pending, not passed.

rows.industry: Resin, paint, and plastics and rubber (NAICS 3252, 3255 and 326); a floor, because some counties are withheld
rows.label: Concentration

rows.industry: All chemical manufacturing plus plastics and rubber (NAICS 325 and 326), counted once
